summary: Unnamed contact who reached out asking to have a disabled Instagram account recovered — the account was fully disabled (not just appealed/restricted) and he was walked through logging in via Safari to pull up the specific violation reason. Quoted $4,000 for this ban type with a 0–48 hour turnaround; he reacted with sticker shock ("Dam / Hmmmmm") and the phone owner said he'd check with another vendor on pricing. No payment or commitment was confirmed before the thread drifted off-topic, so this is an open, unclosed lead that needs a follow-up on price. He asked whether someone had paid to get him banned (targeted report), suggesting he suspects a mass-report attack on a long-standing personal IG.
key_facts: Quoted $4,000 for this specific Instagram ban type
Account was disabled, not merely restricted; already appealed
Deal NOT closed — he balked at the price and owner was checking another vendor for a better rate
Suspects he was deliberately targeted/mass-reported; asked 'did somebody pay to get me banned'
Says he'd had the IG for years and is 'prime' (established/verified-tier account)
Mentions a third party: 'he said he gon talk to cuffem about tomorrow' — possible referral or associate
Phone owner's messages initially landed in his spam filter, delaying the reply
Note: the 5 image attachments could not be opened (macOS permission denied on ~/Library/Messages/Attachments), so the exact @handle and violation text were not extracted
